:::{#sol-rank-practice}

$\operatorname{rank}(\matr{A}) = 2$.
The third [column of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) adds up the first two:
$\tp{(1, 0, 2)} + \tp{(0, 1, 1)} = \tp{(1, 1, 3)}$,
so the three are not [linearly independent](#def-linearly-independent).
The first two are:
if $c_1 \tp{(1, 0, 2)} + c_2 \tp{(0, 1, 1)} = \vzero$,
then the first entry gives $c_1 = 0$ and the second gives $c_2 = 0$.
By @def-rank,
the [rank](#def-rank) is $2$.

:::
